q: The Margulis normal subgroup theorem states that for an irreducible lattice Γ in a higher-rank semisimple Lie group G, any normal subgroup N ⊲ Γ is either:
opts: Finite or of finite index in Γ
exp: Margulis's normal subgroup theorem: for lattices in higher-rank groups (ℝ-rank ≥ 2), every normal subgroup is either finite or has finite index. This 'simplicity modulo finite' shows lattices are highly rigid—far from having rich normal subgroup structure like free groups.
